reported_error: SeSecurityPrivilege missing while preparing the installation
fix: Replace Set-Acl with direct .NET persistence of a newly constructed access-only FileSecurity object. Only access rules are modified. Read back access rules without audit privileges and validate the three intended identities, full control and disabled inheritance.
storage_privileges: No administrator or audit privilege is requested for the user's private files. WSL feature activation and network configuration remain separate elevated operations.
related_fix: Detect mapped network drives such as Z: using DriveInfo.DriveType, in addition to UNC paths; stage archives locally before WSL import, reject network-backed active WSL paths and account for the extra local model copy.
diagnostics: Wizard failures before engine startup also log installer version, error identifier and stack location, with the visible HF token redacted.
version_policy: Central VERSION file. User-requested future release increments: +0.1, next 1.2, then 1.3. No further patch-version releases.
previous_fix_retained: Windows PowerShell 5.1 JSON arrays are explicitly enumerated; ExpectedBytes receives one integer.
